notes: cics-crucible commarea-mismatch / ca-address-twa-tctua (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): ADDRESS TWA and ADDRESS TCTUA. The TWA and TCTUA sizes are stated per scenario (twasize, userarealen; register X59, #5079). The crucible's two-task TCTUA scenario (S then R) is two single-step scenarios here: the harness does not carry a TCTUA across scenarios, so R reads a fresh area. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: twa-sized
scenarios.why: TWASIZE 32: the caller stamps the TWA, the LINKed callee reads it and writes its reply through its own ADDRESS TWA

scenarios.name: tctua-store
scenarios.why: TYPETERM USERAREALEN 16: a stamp is written through ADDRESS TCTUA

scenarios.name: tctua-read
scenarios.why: ADDRESS TCTUA read in a task of its own: the area is the terminal's own 16 bytes

scenarios.name: unknown-mode
scenarios.why: mode X matches no WHEN: the EVALUATE falls through

scenarios.name: twasize-set
scenarios.why: mode Z with a 32-byte TWA: ADDRESS TWA is a real address, so the PRESENT arm of the Z check
